messages.snippet: Nadia, Privileged and without prejudice. Following counsel's advice I propose we make a first offer
messages.subject: Caldervale — proposed settlement offer (privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Privileged and without prejudice. Following counsel's advice I propose we make a first offer of £585,000 inclusive of interest, each side bearing its own costs, open for 21 days, framed as Part 36/Calderbank. That sits just below the risk-adjusted value and puts costs pressure on them given the weakness of their set-off. Are you content for me to send it to Birchall Stone?

Tom
